author: श्रीराघवेन्द्रस्वामी
commentary: सन्तुष्टः अलम्बुद्धिमान् । योगी कर्मध्यानरूपज्ञानोपायवान् । यतात्मा विषयेभ्य उपसंहृतचित्तः । दृढनिश्चयः अप्रामाण्यशङ्काशून्यतत्त्वनिश्चयवान् । मय्यर्पिते मनोबुद्धी यस्य स तथोक्तः ॥ १२.१४॥
translation:
He who does not think evil to any being, who is friendly and full of compassion, without attachment and egoism, equal (possessing equanimity) under pleasure and pain, and is forgiving, even content and practising the yoga of duties and contemplation, with the mind restrained firm in conclusions, who with the mind and reason (Buddhi) entrusted to Me becomes My devotee, --- he is beloved of Me (13-14.)
V. Firm in conclusions: whose conclusions with regard to truth are not assailed by doubts as to their accuracy. (13-14.)
